from pathlib import Path

def replace_once(path, old, new):
    p=Path(path); s=p.read_text();
    if s.count(old)!=1:
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: expected one match, got {s.count(old)}')
    p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
